'''Beryann Raleg''' was [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] along with [[Bren Derlin/Legends|Bren Derlin]] after [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Galen Derlin]]'s [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]]. Prior to the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], he attended [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Princess Leia's]] pilot briefing before heading to his fighter and flying as [[Blue Eight/Legends|Blue Eight]] during the battle.<ref name="Clearance" />

==Behind the scenes==
Raleg was first identified in "[[Rogues Gallery (department)|Rogues Gallery: Clearance for Immediate Launch]]" in [[Star Wars Insider 146|''Star Wars Insider'' 146]].
